description: This Java class implements the XBRLResultService interface, providing methods to retrieve and process XBRL data, including database queries, expression evaluation, and data mapping within the Fineract project.

classes.name: XBRLResultServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the XBRLResultService interface, providing methods to generate XBRL data reports based on database queries and expression processing.

methods.name: getXBRLResult
methods.description: Retrieves XBRL data for a specified date range and currency, throwing an exception if mapping is empty.

methods.name: retrieveTaxonomyConfig
methods.description: Fetches and processes taxonomy configuration, mapping taxonomy IDs to calculated BigDecimal values based on database data and expressions.

methods.name: getAccountSql
methods.description: Constructs SQL query string to retrieve account balances within a date range.

methods.name: setupBalanceMap
methods.description: Executes SQL query and maps account glcodes to their balances.

methods.name: processMappingString
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression with placeholders replaced by account balances to compute a BigDecimal value.

methods.name: getGLCodes
methods.description: Extracts GL codes from a template string with placeholders.
